registeredBefore: any 2011-12..2015-16 props line was scored by any study

design.lines: proxy: floor(median of last 10 played) + 0.5, from earlier games only
design.backtestParams: league rates, priors and NB dispersion from the prior season
design.segment: baseline expected minutes strictly below 15 (fixed from the 2023-26 exploratory breakdown)
design.challenger: below 15 expected minutes: the baseline negative binomial with expected minutes x m and minutes SD^2 = (m x SD)^2 + (s x expected)^2 (adjustedProbabilities); unchanged otherwise
design.fit: m = mean(min(minutes,53)/expected) and s = sqrt(max(0, var(ratio) - mean model CV^2)) over unique low-minute player-games of the fit season (fitAdjustment); no line outcome is used
